summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running anything or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item code. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal, placed beside show_cursor and set_alt_screen. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (returns early on legacy consoles), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Nothing was run and nothing was committed; the work was verified by reading only.
